category: 🗨 Social
content:
Thought about posting this in the island chat but I don't want to clog it up with a wall of text. I'm gonna go offline for the rest of the evening, but here's what Leaf is doing for the rest of the night on the island:

Leaf comes to the island with a book clutched tight to her chest. She waves to all of you before finding a nice place to sit. Not out of sight, but far enough to be on her own for a little while. After sitting down beneath a nice palm tree, she takes her leather shoes off and places them next to her so she can burry her feet in the soft sand.  She places the book in her lap and begins reading on page one. Anyone looking at the cover or over her shoulder can see that its a book about dancing. There's plenty of illustrations and explanations of various steps from all over the world. The book is pretty thick and probably meant to be used more as a reference than a cover to cover read, but Leaf reads through it anyway, page by page. While laughter and music play in the background, Leaf just sits, only occasionally stopping her reading to look up at Melora's ocean and watch the waves crash against the sand. For the first time in a while she doesn't look worried or tired, just content, and learning to make dancing her own. 

Tagging <@!339235123759153162> <@!361351593292988425> <@!246711433730064384> <@!363458590461132800> <@!594008151779573762>  since I'm pretty sure you guys were there when Leaf talked more about dancing a few days ago. This is the kind of wholesome character development I've been waiting to write about for a while lol 😊 
Have fun guys!
